versions.name: RXV2-0.9.168-gear-msg
versions.notes: Save gear ratio now pops a confirmation box ("Gear ratio = <n> saved!") instead of only a quiet status line. Added a shared single-button LDRC.alert() helper for tidy acknowledgements.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.167-fs-crsf
versions.notes: Failsafe now defers to the flight-controller on CRSF. A Rotorflight FC overrules receiver-streamed channels on signal loss (its own failsafe is the authority over CRSF), so on CRSF the receiver no longer streams the saved failsafe - it lets the FC take over (configure it in Rotorflight's Failsafe tab). The saved failsafe is KEPT and still applied on signal loss for SBUS / FBUS / IBUS / PPM models that rely on it. No-transmitter boot is still always disarmed-safe.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.166-fs-apply
versions.notes: Completes the failsafe: the saved positions are now applied on IN-FLIGHT signal loss. If the transmitter link is lost after having been connected, the receiver drives every channel to your saved failsafe set and keeps streaming them as valid RC, so the flight-controller holds your chosen failsafe (set the model to a safe posture - motor off for a heli - before saving). If no failsafe is saved, behaviour is unchanged (the FC runs its own failsafe). A no-transmitter power-up still always uses the guaranteed disarmed-safe default, never these values.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.165-headspeed
versions.notes: Two telemetry items added like V1: HEAD SPEED and ESC TEMPERATURE, read from the CRSF telemetry the flight-controller streams (enable RPM + Temperature sensors in Rotorflight telemetry). Head speed = motor RPM / gear ratio, with a configurable GEAR RATIO on the View-channels page (1.0 = direct drive). SAFETY FIX: the receiver now NEVER boots to your saved failsafe positions (those can have the arm/safety switch off); a no-transmitter power-up always uses the guaranteed disarmed-safe default (sticks centred, AUX low). The failsafe Save still stores your positions for later use.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.164-failsafe
versions.notes: Adds a configurable failsafe (no-transmitter) posture, like V1. On the View-channels page there is now a Failsafe section: set every stick and switch where you want the model to sit with no transmitter (e.g. disarmed, motor off) and tap Save - those exact positions are stored in NVS and output when the receiver is powered up without a transmitter. Clear reverts to the built-in safe default (sticks centred, AUX low). Replaces guessing with your real safe positions - e.g. your AUX1 safety channel.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.163-safe-boot
versions.notes: Safer power-up with no transmitter. Until a transmitter connects, the receiver used to output every channel at mid (1500us) - which a flight-controller reads as a centred, ARMED link, so a heli FC tries to stabilise and the swashplate hunts up and down. It now boots into a disarmed/safe posture instead: sticks centred (ch1-5 = 1500) and all AUX channels low (ch6-16 = 500), so any arm/mode switch reads OFF and nothing spins. As soon as the transmitter connects, real values take over; signal loss after a link still holds the last good values. (Assumes the usual arm-switch-low = disarmed convention.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.162-bind-live
versions.notes: The front screen now updates the bind status by itself. Before, after a successful bind the LED went steady (correct) but the home page still said 'Bind mode' until you left and re-opened it. The page now re-checks every few seconds, so it flips to 'Bound' (and clears the amber bind banner) within a couple of seconds of binding — no navigation needed. Same live-refresh that the Rotorflight button uses.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.161-deadband-x10
versions.notes: Fixes a factor-of-10 on the Rates page 'Dynamic deadband filter' (yaw dynamics). It is stored in deci-Hz, so a value of 60 means 6.0 Hz — the page was showing the raw 60 instead of 6.0. Now displayed and saved in Hz to match the Configurator. The other yaw-dynamics fields were already correct.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.160-actual-cols
versions.notes: Tidies the Rates page for the ACTUAL rate type (Rotorflight 2.2 default) to match the official Configurator: columns are now Centre / Max Rate / Expo / Max Vel (instead of the old generic Centre / Expo / Max plus two always-zero Resp/Accel columns). Values were already correct; this just lays them out the same as the Configurator, like the ROTORFLIGHT type already does.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.159-rf22-detect
versions.notes: Fixes Rotorflight 2.2 detection. The receiver was mis-mapping the FC API version, so a 2.2 flight-controller (API 12.8) was tagged as "1.x" and ALL Rotorflight options disappeared. The mapping is corrected (API 12.8 = RF 2.2, 12.9 = RF 2.3, etc.), so 2.2 is recognised and its config pages appear and read the right version. Following V1: on 2.2 you get everything EXCEPT the two Governor pages (governor needs Rotorflight 2.3 / API 12.9), which are now hidden on 2.2 rather than opening to a disabled page.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.158-rf-btn-live
versions.notes: The home-screen "Rotorflight config" button now appears (and disappears) on its own as the flight-controller is detected, instead of only being decided once when the page opened. Detecting an FC over CRSF can take a few seconds, so previously the button was intermittently missing and only showed up if you re-opened the front screen after it had been found. Now the page re-checks every few seconds. (Note: this only reveals the button once the receiver actually hears the FC — if it never appears, the receiver isn't getting any telemetry back from the FC, which is a wiring/return-path issue, not this.)

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.157-rates-curve
versions.notes: Cosmetic follow-up to 0.9.156: the Rates preview curve now plots Roll/Pitch/Yaw on one shared deg/s scale (so Yaw at 400 visibly rises above Roll/Pitch at 250, like the official Configurator) while Collective keeps its own scale. Numbers were already correct; this just makes the curve picture match.
